messages:
sam: Aurora flagged a billing discrepancy on May reserved instance charges. They say one overage line should be a promo credit.
maria: Invoice id? amount?
sam: INV-2026-0525-007. Line: OVERAGE-DATA (May) $2,400. The customer says we promised a promo credit for the first month of onboarding; that credit wasn't applied. They want $2,400 applied as credit/refund.
aurora-support: Confirmed. We received the onboarding promo email on 2026-05-10. The promo code PROMO-ONBOARD-2026 should have applied to their second invoice but didn't.
oliver: Quick checks: promo code exists, rules show eligible for first 30 days, but promo evaluation failed on invoice generation due to missing promo tag in account meta. Likely our promo-sync job missed them.
maria: Since amount <$5k, finance manager approval is sufficient. We need: 1) product/eng confirm root cause, 2) account owner approval to waive, 3) ledger note.
rachel: Account owner (Hannah) OK'ed the credit in DM: "Yes please apply the onboarding credit and confirm."
finance-bot: Ledger policy check: refunds <=$5k require manager approval only.
maria: I approve applying a $2,400 credit to INV-2026-0525-007. Oliver, please run the billing-tool commands and add a ledger memo referencing ENG-TASK-2026-559 for the promo-sync fix.
oliver: Running commands now:
```nbilling-tool credit-create --customer cust_2HPT --invoice INV-2026-0525-007 --amount 2400.00 --currency USD --reason "Onboarding promo credit not applied" --gl-code PROMO-CR
billing-tool refund-issue --customer cust_2HPT --amount 2400.00 --method stripe --note "Onboarding promo refund"
```
(finance-bot will record txn)
finance-bot: Credit memo cm_4f2a1 created; refund_txn_77a4b queued pending settlement.
sam: Thanks team. I've linked ENG-TASK-2026-559 to the billing note and added the customer's promo email to the ticket. Aurora appreciates the quick turnaround.
